decisions.reason: The three-second attention window is a hook-specific tactic and does not change the existing sales or CPL performance objective.
The attention-window specification does not change how the creative must use or adapt the winning reference.
The hook timing does not change the testimonial format or the source of testimonial content.
The three-second opening-hook window does not alter the video count, total duration, or aspect ratios in the output package.
The hook timing leaves the required UGC visual style and realism criteria unchanged.
The attention-window specification does not change the freelancer's full-service production responsibility or supplied production elements.
The opening-hook timing is unrelated to the deferred landing-page and tracking audit and does not change its state or scope.
